description.zh: Anthropic API Key 账号类型（anthropic 平台及其端点由核心内置；插件构造本类型账号的上游请求，由核心发送；模型价格由管理员在核心中配置）。
description.en: Anthropic API key account type. The anthropic platform and its endpoints are built into the core; the plugin builds the upstream requests of its accounts and the core sends them. Model prices are set by administrators in the core.
